country.match: Match each natural landmark to its country.
country.odd: Three of these natural landmarks are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Denali
rows.description: highest mountain in North America, located in Alaska
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in North America, long known by a president's name before reverting to its native one

rows.label: Mount Kilimanjaro
rows.description: mountain massif in Kilimanjaro National Park in Tanzania
rows.hook: is Africa's tallest peak, a snow-capped giant that trekkers can climb without ropes

rows.label: Dolomites
rows.description: mountain range in the Alps
rows.hook: is a range of pale, jagged Alpine peaks famed for ski resorts and a pink glow at sunset

rows.label: Mount Whitney
rows.description: highest mountain in California and the contiguous United States
rows.hook: is the tallest peak among the lower 48 states, a popular hiking goal in the Sierra Nevada

rows.label: Mount St. Helens
rows.description: volcano in Washington state
rows.hook: lost its summit in a devastating Pacific Northwest eruption that blanketed the region in ash

rows.label: Mount Vesuvius
rows.description: active stratovolcano in the Gulf of Naples, Italy
rows.hook: is the volcano that buried the Roman towns of Pompeii and Herculaneum in ash

rows.label: Mount Fuji
rows.description: volcano in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures, Japan
rows.hook: is a snow-capped, near-perfect cone and a beloved national symbol seen in countless woodblock prints

rows.label: Mount Rainier
rows.description: stratovolcano in the U.S. state of Washington
rows.hook: looms over Seattle and is considered one of the most dangerous volcanoes because of its glaciers and mudflows

rows.label: Mount Etna
rows.description: active stratovolcano on the east coast of Sicily, Italy
rows.hook: is the tallest active volcano in Europe, frequently erupting on a Mediterranean island

rows.label: Mount Ararat
rows.description: highest peak in Turkey
rows.hook: is a twin-peaked, snowy giant traditionally said to be where Noah's ark came to rest

rows.label: Mount Olympus
rows.description: mountain in Elassona municipality, Greece
rows.hook: was believed in ancient myth to be the home of Zeus and the twelve gods

rows.label: Uluru
rows.description: large sandstone isolated mount in Australia
rows.hook: is a giant red sandstone monolith, sacred to Aboriginal people, that glows at sunrise and sunset

rows.label: Mauna Kea
rows.description: Hawaiian volcano

rows.label: Atacama Desert
rows.description: desert in South America
rows.hook: is the driest non-polar place on Earth, so dark and clear that astronomers build observatories here

rows.label: Mount Elbrus
rows.description: highest mountain of the Caucasus and highest mountain in Europe
rows.hook: is a dormant twin-coned volcano in the Caucasus, often named as the tallest peak in Europe

rows.label: Death Valley
rows.description: desert basin in Inyo and San Bernadino counties in California, United States
rows.hook: holds the record for the hottest air temperature ever reliably measured on Earth

rows.label: Ural Mountains
rows.description: mountain range in Eurasia
rows.hook: form the traditional boundary between Europe and Asia

rows.label: Ben Nevis
rows.description: highest mountain of Great Britain
rows.hook: is the highest peak in the British Isles, often climbed in a charity challenge with two others

rows.label: Mojave Desert
rows.description: desert in southwestern United States
rows.hook: is a hot, dry expanse of Joshua trees and cacti that surrounds Las Vegas and borders Death Valley

rows.label: Devils Tower
rows.description: mountain near Moorcroft, Wyoming, United States
rows.hook: is a striking rock column made famous by a Spielberg film about alien contact

rows.label: Tambora
rows.description: stratovolcano on the island of Sumbawa in Indonesia

rows.label: Mauna Loa
rows.description: volcano on the island of Hawaii in Hawaii, United States

rows.label: Western Ghats
rows.description: mountain range along the western coast of India

rows.label: Mount Kosciuszko
rows.description: highest mountain in the mainland of the Australian continent, located on New South Wales–Victoria border

rows.label: Puncak Jaya
rows.description: highest mountain in Oceania and the highest island peak in the world

rows.label: Kīlauea
rows.description: active volcano in Hawaii
rows.hook: is one of the world's most active volcanoes, pouring lava down the Big Island of Hawaii

rows.label: Teide
rows.description: volcano on Tenerife in the Canary Islands

rows.label: Pinatubo
rows.description: active stratovolcano on the island of Luzon in the Philippines
rows.hook: produced one of the biggest eruptions of the 20th century, briefly cooling the whole planet

rows.label: Chimborazo
rows.description: volcano and highest mountain in Ecuador

rows.label: Snowdon
rows.description: highest mountain in Wales
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in Wales, with a mountain railway running to its summit

rows.label: Black Hills
rows.description: mountain range in South Dakota and Wyoming and holy site of Native Americans
rows.hook: is the sacred range of the Lakota that holds a granite carving of four presidents

rows.label: Mount Logan
rows.description: highest mountain in Canada, in Yukon
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in its nation and the second tallest in North America, with an enormous base

rows.label: Mount Tai
rows.description: mountain in Shandong, China

rows.label: Eiger
rows.description: mountain in the Bernese Alps, Switzerland
rows.hook: is a notorious Alpine peak whose steep north face is known as the Murder Wall

rows.label: Mount Kinabalu
rows.description: mountain in Malaysia
